objects.taxonomy_description: Adult male bird exhibiting pronounced sexual dimorphism from female. Body is compact and robust measuring 30-70 cm in length depending on species. Plumage is characterized by vivid, iridescent coloration with metallic green, blue, purple, or copper tones on the neck, breast, and tail feathers. Hackle feathers (neck plumage) are elongated, pointed, and glossy, forming a distinctive ruff around the neck. Saddle feathers (lower back) are elongated and flowing. Tail feathers are long, curved, and iridescent with a characteristic arching posture. Comb is a fleshy, serrated crest on the crown, bright red and vascularized; size and shape vary by breed. Wattles are paired fleshy appendages hanging from the lower beak, also bright red. Beak is short, curved, and keratinous with a yellow to grey coloration. Legs are stout with thick, scaled skin and a prominent posterior spur (calcified projection) on the tarsus used in combat. Feet are anisodactyl (three toes forward, one backward) with sharp, curved claws. The bird exhibits an upright, alert posture with chest puffed and tail elevated.

objects.taxonomy_description: Time-telling device designed for wall mounting with a circular face 20-40 cm in diameter. Face features hour numerals (Arabic, Roman, or markers) arranged in a 12-hour circle. Two or three hands (hour, minute, second) rotate from the center. Frame is wood, metal, or plastic in various finishes (oak, black, white, brass). Mounting bracket or keyhole slot on the back. Quartz movement powered by a single AA battery. Glass or plastic crystal covers the face. Some models have a pendulum visible below the face. Overall depth is 5-10 cm.
